newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ASX substantial shareholding notices - March 20.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ASX substantial shareholding notices - March 20.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices have been made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).
Corporate Express Inc decreased its relevant interest in Corporate Express Australia Limited on 10/03/1997, from 49,300,328 ordinary hares (54.60%) to 49,300,328 ordinary shares (52.42%).
Andale Nominees Pty Limited increased its relevant interest in International Distillers Holdings Limited on 17/03/1997, from 27,190,822 ordinary shares (85.52%) to 27,640,822 ordinary shares 86.94%).
Colonial Ltd increased its relevant interest in Ridley Corporation Limited on 19/03/1997, from 22,821,712 ordinary shares (10.26%) to 8,923,386 ordinary shares (13.29%).
Colonial Limited decreased its relevant interest in Transurban Group on 13/03/1997, from 110,386 ordinary shares (12.13%) to 89,672 ordinary shares (9.85%).
Ashton Mining Limited increased its relevant interest in Australian Diamond Exploration NL on 18/03/1997, from 41,643,889 ordinary shares to 43,082,289 ordinary shares (97.14%).
- - - - Mercury Asset Management Plc increased its relevant interest in Acacia Resources Limited on 17/03/1997, from 15,545,629 ordinary shares (6.17%) to 17,763,339 ordinary shares (7.05%).
A.Y.L. Wong increased its relevant interest in Barton Capital Holdings Limited on 18/03/1997, from 4,375,337 ordinary shares (13.2%) to 5,004,426 ordinary shares (15.1%).

Australian Mutual Provident Society increased its relevant interest in Reinsurance Australia Corporation Limited on 19/03/1997, from 9,253,022 ordinary shares (5.51%) to 10,971,141 ordinary shares (6.65%).
NatWest Markets Australia Limited increased its relevant interest in Mcconnell Dowell Corporation Limited on 19/03/1997, from - ordinary shares (14.32%) to 5,714,883 ordinary shares (13.75%).
Dato' Yap Lim Sen decreased its relevant interest in Ipoh Limited on 14/03/1997, from 7,226,490 ordinary shares (9.99%) to 10,079,311 ordinary shares (9.50%). (Increase in issued capital)
Puspita Emas Sdn Bhd increased its relevant interest in Beach Petroleum NL on 17/03/1997, from 16,861,27 ordinary shares (6.11%) to 39,290,123 ordinary shares (14.24%).
Enterprise Gold Mines NL ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Beach Petroleum NL on 17/03/1997.

Britannia Gold NL became a substantial shareholder in Welcome Stranger Mining Company NL on 16/03/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 10,590,420 ordinary shares (20.69%).

Nautica Investment Fund Pty Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Cambridge Gulf Exploration NL on 07/02/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 20,847,939 ordinary shares (28.65%) fully paid share and 24,867,382 (91.91) partly paid shares.
